values.meaning: Duration extension on takedown within 3 seconds of damaging
values.quote: extend ''Final Hour's'' duration by 4 seconds, up to its original duration

mechanics.claim: Final Hour grants bonus attack damage for its duration, which is a flat self-buff usable for the whole fight window.
The 4-second duration extension requires damaging the target and then scoring a takedown within 3 seconds of that damage; it does not apply against a target that cannot be killed.
mechanics.quote: Scoring an enemy champion {{tip|takedown}} within 3 seconds of damaging them will extend ''Final Hour's'' duration by 4 seconds, up to its original duration.

mechanics.claim: Final Hour has no cast time and its cooldown starts on cast.
Basic attacking breaks the stealth granted by empowered Tumble at the start of the attack windup, but does not by itself end Final Hour.
mechanics.quote: Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the start of the attack windup.
